mistake_reason: At step 2, the Assistant asserted with absolute certainty that the quoted writer was George Packer and fabricated a specific URL and quote context without any tool-based verification. Subsequent browsing attempts revealed the provided URL was invalid (404) and no corroborating evidence was obtained. This matches FM-4.1 (Hallucination): the agent generated factually incorrect information without grounding in tools or data, relying on invented citation details.
